caption:
Mr Turtle has seen a hundred treatment videos online, and they all say something different.

Evidence-based care blends three things: current research, your practitioner's clinical experience, and your own goals and preferences. For many muscle and joint problems, current guidelines usually put exercise and education first, with hands-on care as a helpful add-on.

It also means being upfront when evidence is thin, measuring progress, and changing the plan or referring on to your GP or another practitioner if things stall.

Questions about your plan are always welcome at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
